ambiguities.detail: Burg Sonnenfels is not a named point on this supplied map. Only southern Weisenfluh and its existing family are proven. Preserve castle seat and leave specific province/liege open; no invented relocation.

Aurelmark and Edelstrom are labelled Grafschaft, but no source labels one of their seats gräflich and user names no Graf. Main Baronien imply Freiherren, Hartenfels/Aldermoor imply Junker; immediate Grafenhaus remains unknown. Do not silently promote Arenberg/Lanvier/Berden to Graf or assert direct sovereign vassalage.
User makes Velten Graf at Hasselt. Map shows Hasselt as Baronie within Borgeln; provisional liege Rothman comes from map hierarchy only and should remain separately qualified.

Non-ruling residents of Ewiggrün, Weislauf and Ewigensee are marked Junker by analogous specified main-seat pattern. The task text expressly stated others Junker at Weishort/Seeblick only; these remaining ranks are not individually express statements.
Order territory is explicitly leased; source does not name lessor. Preserve order identity and leave liege open.
Current country-specific rank terms change to Freiherr/Junker/Ministerialer. Historical 1736 accounts and foreign Cenyr ranks must not be globally search-replaced.
